title: DitchBook — Colorado ditch company to WDID matches (tier-1)
description: Verified matches between Colorado mutual ditch and reservoir companies (as registered with the Colorado Secretary of State) and their water structures (WDIDs) in Colorado DWR records — the organization-to-WDID relationship that public state datasets stopped exposing directly. 463 companies are matched at tier-1: published only where state records agree beyond doubt, with a citation URL to the underlying DWR record on every row. Ambiguous candidates are excluded, not guessed.
